core_obligations: Choose a surjective morphism U -> X with U a scheme and check that quasi-affineness may be tested after this base change (proof lines 4281-4283).
Use the base change formula for pushforwards and the base change compatibility of the relative spectrum to reduce the factorization to the base changed situation (proof lines 4283-4289).
Observe that if X is a scheme and either condition holds then Y is a scheme as well (proof lines 4290-4292).
Apply the scheme case of the characterization to conclude (proof lines 4292-4293).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f : Y -> X of algebraic spaces is quasi-affine if and only if the canonical factorization Y -> Spec_X(f_*O_Y) is an open immersion (source lines 4270-4278). The proof performs a three-step reduction to the scheme case: quasi-affineness may be checked after a surjective base change U -> X with U a scheme, the pushforward of O_Y restricts to the pushforward along the base change, and the formation of the relative spectrum commutes with base change; once X is a scheme, both conditions force Y to be a scheme, and the statement becomes the scheme case.
